title: Remove duplicate Completed output open action
summary: Removes the duplicate Completed-page Open Output File action from the shared WebView row-open action list while keeping Play Output as the primary completed-output file action.
reason: The operator reported that Open Output File duplicates Play Output and that Play Output better communicates the action's meaning.
behavior_before: Completed row actions exposed both Play Output and Open Output File for the completed output payload, creating two file-open controls for the same output.
behavior_after: Completed row actions expose Play Output as the sole completed-output file action, while output-folder, sidecar, and source-folder actions remain available.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/app/rowOpenActions.js tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py ops/release/changes/unreleased/MP-CHANGE-2026-0606-009.json - passed (3 summaries written)
rollback_plan: Restore the completed Open Output File action in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/app/rowOpenActions.js, remove the static no-label assertion, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView/static validation.
notes:
Frontend-only action-list cleanup. It does not change backend open-policy routes, media policy, output paths, publish/drain, source/scratch/output movement, rename, or filesystem mutation behavior.
